title: PIIS — Portable Integration Interface Specification: Working Draft 02 (Spanish and English)
description: Working Draft 02 of the Portable Integration Interface Specification (PIIS), an exploratory proposal for portable functional definitions and observable contracts for integration interfaces across independent implementation technologies. Includes the complete original Spanish draft and full English translation. The document proposes functionality-preserving migration, measurable conformance, and outcome-driven end-to-end comparisons. It is not an approved standard or an RFC.
